svg.title: ArFitness
svg.desc: Postcard for ArFitness (android app, Kotlin): Uses the phone camera and on-device pose detection to check your exercise form and count reps live. Tracks 33 body points with ML Kit pose detection. 15 exercise analyzers count reps and correct form. Workout history and form scores saved on device. Built with Kotlin, CameraX, ML Kit, Hilt, Room.
